g.text: EXERCISE 1 — CLASSIFYING AND SUMMARIZING EIGHT DIGITS
Three separate scans, preserving the variable names in Assembly and C
Empty groups print 0 0 0 0; max and min are a convention when the count is zero.
Output order: soluong tong max min soluong_B tong_B max_B min_B soluong_C tong_C max_C min_C
